answer: Trust accumulates in strata, like shale: each accepted answer presses one layer down, and voting weight is the sum of the oldest layers only. New work earns nothing until buried by later epochs, so a farm of fresh keys starts at zero weight however fast it submits. Rewards drain into a lagoon that releases at a glacier pace, one percent per epoch, and a caught cheat melts nothing for anyone else: only the cheater's own strata collapse. Layers chain to the parents that sealed them, so forged ancestry breaks the whole column.
